FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Military Backend Changes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Handful of changes to the military backend for submod support.

patchNoteLines.li: Add RaidWeightRegistry and associated interface, for submods to influence the raid weighting for Empire settlements
Add UnitOverlayRegistry and associated interface, for submods to add information to the military squad screen
Add MercenaryDeathEvent, for submods to potentially intercept mercenary deaths

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: "Ghost" Caravan Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a couple of issues that might cause "Ghost" caravans

patchNoteLines.li: If a delivery good can't be added to a pawn for some reason, then it is placed at the tax spot, instead of silently destroyed
Tax delivery method is locked in at event creation time, rather than delivery time

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Resource-DLC Patch
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a DLC-access issue for some resources.

patchNoteLines.li: Move the tech-gates on Deathrest capacity serum and Sentience catalyst off of the base RTD_Medicine def and into DLC-gated XML patches
Move BlocksVacstone off of the base RTD_Mining and into a DLC-gated xml patch

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.
